card.name: Word stem just before a closing -s or -ing
card.fires_on: The stem of a word when the next piece is a short ending such as s, ing or ation. It is most often seen in all-caps label text, e.g. CASE before S, LEVEL before S, or Ed before s.

modes.label: Capitalized stem before plural S
modes.description: An all-caps word stem right before a final S in uppercase warning text.
modes.example: IN SOME<< CASE>>S, ALLOW THE DETECTION OF

modes.label: Abbreviation or stem before an ending
modes.description: A short stem such as Ed or plant, followed by s or ation.

modes.label: Verb stem before -s
modes.description: An all-caps verb stem that takes a third-person s.
modes.example: EXPERIENCE SUG<<GEST>>S THAT ACUTE LIVER FAILURE IS

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish the word with a short ending like s, ments or ently.
card.plain: It fires on a word stem that is about to be completed by a small ending, mostly in capital-letter label text.
